derived_copy_of_original_protocol.decision_rule: No tuning, retries, trimming or best-of selection after measurements.
limits: One bounded owned-buffer kernel, not multiple independent applications.
63 batch samples per backend/size; p99 equals the observed maximum, not per-call p99.
One shared host; affinity does not imply exclusive CPU or stable frequency.
Energy, manual engineering and past tool acquisition are unknown.
derived_copy_of_original_protocol.order: rotate backends by seed index, reverse odd rotations; preserve every sample
derived_copy_of_original_protocol.semantics: n <= 65536, seed u32; allocate n zeroed bytes, fill byte[i]=(i+seed) mod 256, return u64 sum and release; empty allocation has no malloc; allocation refusal returns 1001
